candidate_selection.rule: Nine new candidates, three per company type, selected by a blinded agent before future-job search. Each candidate has at least two diverse upstream event types, except one foreign candidate admitted by the predeclared single A-grade operational-event rule.

freeze_rule: After the pre-prediction seal, do not change evidence, prompt, ontology, matcher, thresholds or candidate universe. Run and freeze predictions before any future-job label search.
